change_reason: Live MAST schema validation accepts duplicate_id and rejects the v1 duplicate_i column before returning rows.
purpose: Bounded leakage-safe pilot matching cached training-only TESS TICs to publication-backed Catalina variability labels

catalog.cache_policy: shared read-only hash-pinned input; one locked atomic download across all shards

coordinate_contract.catalog_coordinates: VizieR RAJ2000/DEJ2000 derived from the fixed-width J2000 fields
coordinate_contract.tic_coordinates: MAST TIC ra/dec; proper motion retained for audit but not applied because both match coordinates are J2000
coordinate_contract.high_proper_motion_guard: Any future epoch propagation requires a separately pinned epoch contract; this pilot does not infer one.

pilot.shape: six modulo shards; six MAST batch workers per shard; six TIC IDs per request
pilot.scale_decision: Compare aggregate TIC/s, missing rows, retries, timeouts, accepted/rejected matches, and cross-shard duplicate Catalina IDs before authorizing all 2790 TICs.

label_mapping.rule: Preserve class_code and class_flag in every match; benchmark_family is a derived convenience field only.

limitations: This contract authorizes only a deterministic 216-TIC metadata/crossmatch pilot.
Pilot matches are not training labels until all six shards are globally reconciled for duplicate Catalina sources and the scientific overlap is accepted in a separate evidence gate.
No FITS light curve is opened, no embedding is extracted, and no model is trained or promoted.
The Catalina sky footprint and magnitude range may yield too few matches; a low overlap is an evidence result, not permission to relax safeguards after seeing labels.
